note: The Lean order p carries a mesh and a period sequence, and p.per composed with q.per plays P = p o q; the conclusion adds Final, reconstruction, OPE and contact data to the convergence and E1-E7, and needs G.Simple and a penalty b>0 that [M] takes as standing assumptions.

theorem continuum {G : Gauge} (hG : G.Simple) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    let R := fundedRun hG hb
    R.family.path.levels.clock.kernel.penalty = b ∧
    ∀ p : Extraction.Order, ∃ (q : Extraction.Order) (S : Table R.family.book)
      (F : Final R.family (p.refine q) S) (L : EveryPhase.Almanac F)
      (Q : Reader F.sector.derivatives F.sector.turns F.room.kernel.spin)
      (M : Contacts.Devices F.sector.derivatives),
      (Extraction.Order.mk Extraction.Sequence.full (p.refine q).per).Ordered R.family S ∧
      FullVolume.PositionsUV R.family Extraction.Sequence.full ∧ Core.{u,v} hG F L Q ∧
      OPE.Nesting.Uniform F Q ∧ M.basis = Q.port ∧ MultipleLight F M ∧
      Nonempty (Contacts.Transport.SystemBasis M) ∧ Nonempty (Thresholds M) := by

theorem constructed (g : GaugeGroup) (hg : g.IsSimple) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∃ C : YM.Family g.core, C.path.levels.clock.kernel.penalty = b ∧ C.Makes ∧
      WilsonRegularity (wilsonFamily C) ∧
      ∀ p : Extraction.Order, ∃ (q : Extraction.Order) (S : Table C.book)
        (F : Final C (p.refine q) S) (L : EveryPhase.Almanac F)
        (Q : Reader F.sector.derivatives F.sector.turns F.room.kernel.spin)
        (M : Contacts.Devices F.sector.derivatives) (X : Climb.Scaling S),
        (hierarchy F Q).Properties (p.refine q).per ∧ (hierarchy F Q).Contacts ∧
        (Extraction.Order.mk Extraction.Sequence.full (p.refine q).per).Ordered C S ∧
        FullVolume.PositionsUV C Extraction.Sequence.full ∧ Spec.Calibrated C ∧
        Independent.Core.{u,v} (GaugeGroup.coreSimple hg) F L Q ∧
        Headline.Reconstruction F L ∧
        (∀ i, (view (L.actors i)).Axioms) ∧
        Headline.SeparatedOPE F Q ∧ Headline.NestedOPE F Q ∧ Headline.TraceExclusions.{u,v} F ∧
  …
